findings.title: Gaza weather system threatens 1.3M Palestinians with humanitarian disaster
findings.affected_population_system: Civil Defense spokesperson Mahmoud Basal warns that 200,000 deteriorating tents and 1,000 shelters are at risk of flooding in expected severe weather. He reports critical shortages of fuel, vehicle maintenance supplies, rapid-response vehicles and water pumps. Forecast risk and current response constraints, not verified new flood damage.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: 200,000 deteriorating tents and 1,000 shelters are at risk of flooding.
findings.source_type: News agency reporting attributed to Civil Defense spokesperson

bounded_discovery_context.method: Anadolu linked latest-news discovery and direct article inspection after official checks; deduplicated against 14 authenticated November 27 and eight November 26 evening heartbeats.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Specific Civil Defense warning and rescue capacity constraints not present in reviewed ledger. Distinct from older general winter shelter figures.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Anadolu displays November 28 publisher date; the report attributes warning to Friday November 27. The observation window is November 27 Pacific time; exact publication time/timezone unknown. Figures are attributed estimates and not independently audited.

findings.title: Red Cross sounds alarm about Gaza winter as displaced face unsafe shelter choices
findings.affected_population_system: ICRC spokesperson Amani al-Nawouq describes sewage system as unable to function and extensive damage to water distribution infrastructure, amplifying flood and waterborne disease risks. She reports entry restrictions on durable shelter and infrastructure repair materials.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Gaza’s sewage system has become completely unable to function
findings.source_type: News agency direct interview with ICRC spokesperson

bounded_discovery_context.method: Anadolu linked latest-news discovery and direct article inspection after official checks; deduplicated against 14 authenticated November 27 and eight November 26 evening heartbeats.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: New explicit ICRC characterization of sewage functioning capacity, distinct from earlier OCHA damage and disease reports. General winter shelter figures not repeated.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: No precise geographic operational breakdown, outage onset or independent corroboration. Attributed assessment, not proof that every individual sewage facility has stopped.

findings.title: Israel's use of Palestinians as human shields in Gaza widespread, encouraged by commanders: Report
findings.affected_population_system: Palestinian civilians reportedly subjected to forced participation in dangerous military activity; Anadolu cites new Wall Street Journal soldier interviews and an Israeli military official reporting ten suspected Gaza cases under investigation. The reported cases are allegations, not confirmed new incidents or completed investigations.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: authorities are investigating 10 suspected cases of human shield use in Gaza
findings.source_type: News agency reporting on investigative journalism and attributed military official statement

bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Newly recovered Friday investigative reporting and specific Gaza investigation count, not a claim that historical incidents occurred in this hour.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Underlying WSJ investigation was not directly inspected. Anadolu displays November 28 publication date and attributes WSJ reporting to Friday; exact publication time unknown. No claim of newly opened cases.
